audience: HR managers and small business owners who track people, leave and absences in Breathe HR

useCases.title: See who is off and for how many days
useCases.text: The AI lists approved absences with employee, dates, half days and days deducted, filtered by employee, department, type or dates. You see who is away next week.

useCases.title: Check an employee's holiday allowance and days left
useCases.text: The AI reads an employee's holiday years with allowance, days or hours taken, booked and remaining. It can pass a date to get the right year.

useCases.title: Review leave requests and their approval status
useCases.text: The AI lists leave requests with employee, dates, type and status, filtered by employee, department or start-date range, and opens one by id.

useCases.title: Look through employees, departments and expense claims
useCases.text: The AI lists employees with job title, department, line manager and working pattern, and expense claims by employee and state. You get a view of your team and pending claims.

useCases.title: Request leave and approve or reject leave requests
useCases.text: The AI creates a leave request for an employee, approves a pending request so it becomes an absence, or rejects it with a reason the employee sees.
